subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this branch's drop-internal-handoff strategy proceed, or should maintainers prefer the context-only repair strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 for the canonical stale orphan prompt issue?
rationale: Both branches target the same user-visible stale-reply cluster but encode different session-state semantics, and this branch lacks real behavior proof for the exact drop/preserve split.

options.title: Require proof before choosing
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs or terminal output show stale internal handoffs are dropped while `sessions_send` is preserved, then compare it against the proof-backed strategy in the overlapping PR.

options.title: Prefer the broader repair
options.body: If maintainers accept the context-only semantics and proof in the overlapping PR, treat this branch as superseded after that path is selected or merged.

options.title: Accept private maintainer proof
options.body: Proceed only if a maintainer has equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accepts the six-source drop predicate.

recommendation.title: Require proof before choosing
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs or terminal output show stale internal handoffs are dropped while `sessions_send` is preserved, then compare it against the proof-backed strategy in the overlapping PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced by PR #65478.
